name: Dynus Aralas

dialogue.speaker: Dynus Aralas
dialogue.line: New challengers appear from the cold wastes. Are they worthy enough to face The Pack? Let the games a begin!
dialogue.trigger: When you first enter the arena

dialogue.speaker: Dynus Aralas
dialogue.line: Impressive. Let's see if they can handle something a little harder, eh?
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the first wave of gladiators

dialogue.speaker: Dynus Aralas
dialogue.line: It looks as like there's some fight in our challengers, after all. Take them down!
dialogue.trigger: Soon Dynus and the rest of the Pack will take to the arena, as you have proven yourself to be worth fighting for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Snagg gro-Mashul
dialogue.line: Congratulations. You've passed the first trial.
dialogue.trigger: Soon Dynus and the rest of the Pack will take to the arena, as you have proven yourself to be worth fighting for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Kayd at-Sal
dialogue.line: Yeah, they bested the finest sloths, drunkards, and fools we had to offer!
dialogue.trigger: Soon Dynus and the rest of the Pack will take to the arena, as you have proven yourself to be worth fighting for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Nusana
dialogue.line: Adorable. Shall we give them a pendant?

summary: Dynus Aralas is a Dark Elf werewolf found in the Blessed Crucible. Dynus acts as the announcer for the fights before the Pack joins in.
